definitions.explanation: A fervent, emotionally charged speech or argument delivered with great conviction and energy. Implies that the speaker is deeply invested in the topic and speaks with visible enthusiasm.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{熱弁|ねつべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るった→振るう：12793_furuu⟧。
examples.english: The company president delivered a passionate speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{熱弁|ねつべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るった→振るう：12793_furuu⟧。
examples.english: He spoke passionately about environmental issues.

examples.japanese: 1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる{熱弁|ねつべん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{聴衆|ちょうしゅう}→聴衆：13907_choushuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{動|うご}かされた→動かす：01885_ugokasu⟧。
examples.english: The audience was moved by the impassioned speech that lasted an hour.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Almost always used in the set phrase {熱弁|ねつべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ (to deliver a passionate speech). The verb ⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧ is the standard collocate.

USAGE:
Combines ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat, passion) and {弁|べん} (speech, eloquence). Used in formal and semi-formal contexts: political speeches, business presentations, academic debates. Can carry a slightly humorous tone when the speaker's enthusiasm seems excessive for the situation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熱弁|ねつべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}るう→振るう：12793_furuu⟧: to deliver a passionate speech
- {熱弁|ねつべん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ふるう⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧: the sight of someone speaking passionately
